test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

While I was waiting for Asha __for shopping__, I spilled lemonade on my new trousers
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect usage of the phrase "for shopping".
 
• To convey the action of waiting to go shopping, the phrase should be "to shop".
 
• The phrase "to shop" correctly conveys the intended meaning and maintains grammatical accuracy.
 
• Thus, the error is located in the segment "for shopping".

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"While I was waiting for Asha to shop, I spilled lemonade on my new trousers."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "to hold shop" **– This option is incorrect as it does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 2: "to see shopping"** – This option is incorrect as it is grammatically inaccurate and does not convey the intended meaning.
 
• **Option 4: "to shopper"** – This option is incorrect as "shopper" is a noun and does not fit the context of the sentence.
